name: scibrarian
description: Local web app that polls top journals (via PubMed) and shows a per-topic timeline of recent research.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w desktop && npm run start -w desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build -w client && npm run pack -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build -w client && npm run dist -w desktop
